hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */backend/*.py) (cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format "$f" && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix "$f") ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */backend/*) (cd backend && python -m pytest -q) ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */.env|.env) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing .env is blocked: it may contain real local secrets. Edit .env.example instead."}}'; exit 0 ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
